Input: `state` has exactly integer registers `x,y`. `procedures` maps distinct names to instruction lists; `main` is an instruction list. Instructions have exactly one of these forms: `{op:"add",register:"x"|"y",value:integer}`, `{op:"scale",register:"x"|"y",value:integer}`, `{op:"swap"}`, `{op:"call",name:existing_procedure}`, or `{op:"if",test:{register:"x"|"y",cmp:"lt"|"eq"|"ge",value:integer},then:[instructions],else:[instructions]}`. Calls form an acyclic graph, including calls in either branch. Execute main in order against the current state. add increments the indicated register; scale multiplies it; swap exchanges x and y simultaneously. call executes the named procedure in the same shared state and returns before the next instruction; record the procedure name on entry, including repeated and nested calls. if compares the indicated current register with value, records the boolean result, and executes exactly the chosen branch. Record condition results in execution order, including conditions inside procedures. No primitive step is counted for call or if; each executed add, scale, or swap counts once. Return exactly `{after:{x:integer,y:integer},executed_primitives:integer,call_order:[procedure_names],conditions:[booleans]}`. This finite execution task represents composition of explicitly supplied reusable procedures; it does not establish learned skill acquisition.
